items.guidance: Joplin Server is a Koa app in the server package; check its config/env handling (for example an APP_PORT-style variable and its default) and the `start-prod` script to find the real listening port. Only add ENV PORT if the code actually reads PORT; if it reads a differently named variable, EXPOSE the default it uses.

Joplin Server's Koa routes live in the server package; search the route definitions for an existing unauthenticated ping or status-style route and verify it responds 2xx without a session and without touching the database. If adding one, register it in the route table or middleware chain ahead of the session/auth and redirect middleware.

Check whether pg-boss is started from the server's normal startup path (for example a task or queue service initialised when the Koa app boots) or only from a separate entry point or CLI command. Report the file and start path, and whether a dedicated worker mode exists in the server package.

packages/app-clipper is the browser web clipper extension, not part of the server image started by `yarn start-prod`, so the SQS match is likely a false positive from content-script code. Confirm by inspecting that file and report whether any server-side code references SQS.
